items.markdown:
You can use free online sound tools like the [Noise Generator](https://29a.ch/noise-generator/) to `play white, pink, or brown noise directly in your web browser`.[[1]](https://29a.ch/noise-generator/)

### Popular Free Online Noise Generators

- **[myNoise](https://mynoise.net/NoiseMachines/whiteNoiseGenerator.php):** Highly customizable sound generator with adjustable frequency sliders and unique color presets.[[1]](https://mynoise.net/NoiseMachines/whiteNoiseGenerator.php)[[2]](https://noises.online/)
- **[Noises Online](https://noises.online/):** Clean, browser-based audio player featuring pristine, original environmental recordings.[[1]](https://noises.online/)
- **[Online Tone Generator](https://onlinetonegenerator.com/):** Simple tool for playing precise sine, square, sawtooth, or triangle audio waves.[[1]](https://onlinetonegenerator.com/)

### Types of Noise

- **White Noise:** Contains equal energy across all frequencies, sounding like a loud hiss or static, which helps drown out sharp background sounds.
- **Pink Noise:** Decreases in volume as frequency increases, creating a softer, deeper sound similar to steady rain or rustling leaves.
- **Brown/Red Noise:** Drops heavily in high frequencies, producing a very deep, low rumble like a distant waterfall or heavy thunder.
